answer: Intake is a jetty with a finite number of grader berths each epoch. Near-copy answers share one berth because they hash to the same mechanism skeleton, so a fleet of alts still waits in one line. A lantern on that berth records how many grader minutes the cluster already spent; once the budget is gone, further copies are refused. An echo of 400 keys does not buy 400 berths. The 400th fake pays more grader time than the first, which is the scarce resource.
